title: Post-compilation policy integrity
question: Can a manifest-listed generated policy be changed after compilation without invalidating the verification evidence?

controlled_variables.verifier: unchanged except for the manifest integrity gate
controlled_variables.changed_factor: bytes of one generated policy artefact

mutation.description: One trailing whitespace sequence was appended. The JSON remained valid and parsed to the same policy document.

mutated_bundle.reason: compiled policy integrity check failed: transport_policy.generated.json: expected sha256=8fa30f637b66293d34e56d75f4fc6470fc455d7d9f4d987ef5f22b497ee571a5, actual sha256=9e62e0192aafad950a58306a09fd1e37e66e99929f8e3689f9f4a32ca92ffaea

interpretation_boundary: E7 detects post-compilation byte changes to the three generated policy files listed in the retained manifest when the integrity gate executes. It does not authenticate the manifest, eliminate a concurrent check-to-use race, detect coordinated modification of both a policy and its manifest, bind topology, query, or report files to the same run, detect a compromised compiler or verifier, or observe runtime network drift.
